{
  "name": "remctl",
  "displayName": "RemCTL",
  "version": "2.3.1",
  "description": "Apple Reminders in Claude Code: RemCTL's tools, plus today's tasks above the prompt in your lists' colors.",
  "author": {
    "name": "Federico Viticci",
    "url": "https://macstories.net"
  },
  "homepage": "https://github.com/viticci/remctl#use-it-in-claude-code",
  "repository": "https://github.com/viticci/remctl",
  "license": "MIT",
  "keywords": [
    "reminders",
    "tasks",
    "macos",
    "productivity",
    "mod"
  ],
  "types": "./types/index.d.ts",
  "userConfig": {
    "display": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Today: show tasks as",
      "description": "band: a summary and the next tasks above the prompt. compact: one line above the prompt. status: the status line. pane only: just /reminders.",
      "default": "band",
      "options": [
        "band",
        "compact",
        "status",
        "pane only"
      ]
    },
    "rows": {
      "type": "number",
      "title": "Today: tasks in the band",
      "description": "How many tasks the band lists under its summary.",
      "default": 3,
      "min": 0,
      "max": 8
    },
    "includeOverdue": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Today: include overdue tasks",
      "description": "Count and list reminders that were due before today.",
      "default": true
    },
    "lists": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Today: only these lists",
      "description": "Comma-separated Reminders list names. Leave empty for every list.",
      "default": ""
    },
    "checkboxes": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Today: complete from the pane",
      "description": "Show a check button beside each task in /reminders that marks it done in Reminders.",
      "default": true
    },
    "refreshMinutes": {
      "type": "number",
      "title": "Today: refresh every (minutes)",
      "description": "How often to read Reminders again. Changes Claude makes through RemCTL show right away.",
      "default": 5,
      "min": 1,
      "max": 60
    },
    "openOnStart": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Today: open the pane at start",
      "description": "Dock the /reminders pane beside the conversation when a session starts in a wide window.",
      "default": false
    }
  }
}
